name: Healing VR
summary:
Healing VR is designed to relieve anxiety, relax the mind and body, and improve quality of life. Through immersive virtual environments and 3D surround sound, Healing VR elevates meditation and mindfulness to a new level, helping you find tranquility and strength amidst a busy life.

Key Features
🌌 Diverse Healing Spaces
	•	Explore beautifully crafted virtual spaces, including temples, lakes, beaches, forests, the sky, and the cosmos, where you can meditate, unwind, and reconnect with yourself.

🎵 Healing
